caption: The drawing features a vertical vine-like arrangement of botanical elements on a rectangular off-white background centered on a larger, slightly yellowed sheet. At the top, there is a cluster of leaves in varying shades of green, with a brownish stem and a small blue flower with a yellow center above pink and red flower buds. The vine snakes downward, displaying an alternating pattern of stylized pink-red flowers, pairs of bright green rounded leaves outlined in a darker green, and several smaller, detailed foliage elements in darker shades of green. The composition is vertically aligned with the vine and floral design occupying most of the central space in the rectangle, against a light beige and ivory backdrop. There are handwritten annotations in the bottom corners of the larger sheet.
title: Sampler
